artifact.transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Metro Healthcare Clinic. My name is Maya, your AI assistant. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Patient: Hello Maya. My name is Eleanor Vance, and my date of birth is April 15, 1982.
Agent: Thank you Eleanor. What is the primary reason for your call today?
Patient: I need to confirm my appointment for tomorrow at 10 AM with Dr. Harrison and ask if I should fast before my blood test.
Agent: I have confirmed your appointment with Dr. Harrison for tomorrow at 10 AM. Yes, please fast for 8 hours prior to your lab work.
Patient: Perfect, thank you so much!

analysis.summary: Patient Eleanor Vance (DOB: 1982-04-15) called to confirm her appointment with Dr. Harrison scheduled for tomorrow at 10 AM. She inquired about lab fasting requirements. Agent confirmed appointment and instructed 8-hour fasting prior to blood work.
